None of the three solutions is reliable, and I can't verify any of the stated values.

- **Solution 1 (18/5)** and **Solution 3 (36/11)** rest on discharging arguments whose key steps are asserted rather than proved. Solution 3 explicitly defers the degree-3 case to an unspecified "refined analysis." Their tightness claims are also unsupported.
- **Solution 2 (4)** gives a similarly sketched discharging argument, and its tightness claim (that octahedron-based configurations defeat the coloring at mad = 4) is not shown.

The problem is taken from the literature on proper conflict-free list coloring. I recall the relevant threshold being a value near 3 rather than any of the three answers, but I can't confirm the exact constant from memory, so I'm not treating that as a verified answer. No solution's final value is established by the work shown.

CHOICE: NONE
